tickets.subject: Package delayed before a trip
tickets.preview: My shoes still haven’t arrived. Can you help before my trip?

messages.text: Hi! My order was supposed to arrive on Thursday, but the tracking hasn’t moved in four days. I need the shoes for my trip this Sunday. Can you help?
Hi Sarah, I’m sorry the shoes haven’t arrived in time. The tracking information shows a weather delay at the Denver hub, with an estimated delivery of October 28. That date isn’t confirmed yet.

sources.title: Shipping & delivery policy
sources.excerpt: When a carrier reports a delay, share the latest available delivery estimate. If the estimate does not meet the customer’s needs, ask a support specialist to review the available options.

messages.text: Thanks for checking. I’m leaving Sunday morning, so that may be too late. Is there another option?
I’ve asked a support specialist to review the delivery options with you. They’ll confirm what is possible before making any changes to your order.

activity.title: Order lookup
activity.result: Order found. Two line items; total paid $148.50.

activity.title: Carrier tracking lookup
activity.result: Weather delay at Denver hub. Estimated arrival October 28; unconfirmed.

activity.title: Handover requested
activity.result: Customer needs an earlier delivery date. A support specialist needs to review the options.

tickets.subject: Return for faulty headphones
tickets.preview: The left earcup stopped working. How do I return these?

messages.text: The left earcup on my new headphones stopped working. I received them last week. Can I return them for a refund?
Hi Michael, I’m sorry about the fault. Your order is within the 30-day return window. Could you confirm that you would like a refund, rather than a replacement? No return has been created yet.

sources.title: Returns & exchanges
sources.excerpt: Faulty items reported within 30 days of delivery can be reviewed for a refund or replacement. Confirm the customer’s preference before creating a return.

activity.title: Return eligibility lookup
activity.result: Delivered October 21. Within the sample 30-day return window. No return label created.

tickets.subject: Shipping to Germany
tickets.preview: Thanks, that explains the delivery and customs process.

messages.text: Hello, I ordered a canvas tote to Berlin. Does the delivery estimate include time at customs?
Hi Elena, your estimated delivery is October 31–November 3. Customs processing may add time to that estimate. If the carrier needs anything from you, they will contact you directly.

sources.title: Shipping & delivery policy
sources.excerpt: International delivery dates are estimates. Customs processing can extend delivery time; the carrier will notify the recipient if additional information is required.

messages.text: Thanks, that explains it. I’ll keep an eye on the tracking.

activity.title: Shipping policy lookup
activity.result: International shipping policy §3.1 matched. Delivery estimate October 31–November 3.

activity.title: Ticket resolved
activity.result: Customer confirmed their question was answered.

tickets.subject: Ceramic vase arrived damaged
tickets.preview: I’d prefer a replacement if you have the same color.

messages.text: My vase arrived yesterday with a crack down the side. Can someone help me arrange a replacement?
Hi David, I’m sorry your vase arrived damaged. I can review a replacement for you. Would you like the same sand color?
Yes please, I’d prefer a replacement in the same color if it’s available.
Check availability of the large sand vase before confirming a replacement. No replacement order created.

activity.title: Order lookup
activity.result: One large sand vase, $64.00. Delivered October 26. Replacement has not been created.
